---
# Written by hand in an editor. A comment inside the block is not data the format knows about.
title:    Comments and blank lines inside the block

# The blank line above is deliberate, and so are the extra spaces after `title:`.
relation:root: 01a03d55-1a2b-7c3d-8e4f-5a6b7c8d9e0f
---

Comments and blank lines do **not** survive a write, and that is correct rather than regrettable:
stage 1b has one write path and it renders, so lexical choices around an interpreted key are
normalized like any other. What the write path does preserve is an *unknown* key's bytes — see
`01a03d59…` and `01a03d5a…`, which is where the guarantee actually lives.

This fixture is what tells the two apart. A writer that quietly round-tripped the whole block
through the YAML emitter would look identical on every other fixture and differ here.
